detail.title: CP-UVR-1616K8-I3
features: Supports HDCVI, AHD, TVI, CVBS and IP video input
AI Instastream, Instastream, H.265, H.264+, H.264 video compression
24 Channel IP camera input and each channel can be up to 8 MP, 128 Mbps  incoming bandwidth
4 Channel perimeter protection for analog channels which supports                   tripwire and intrusion detection powered by AI
16 Channel IMD+ for analog channels or 24 Channel IMD by camera which             allows the device to trigger accurate alarms for humans and  vehicles
Support 8 SATA HDDs up to 20TB Each, 4 USB Ports, 1 RS232,  1 RS485, 1 eSATA

General.Perimeter Performance AI by DVR:
Advanced Mode: 2 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel
General Mode: 4 channels, 10 IVS rules for each Channel
General.Face Attributes: Gender, Age group, Glasses, Expressions, Face mask, Beard
General.Face Detection Performance AI by DVR: 2 Channels (up to 12 face images/s each channel)
General.Face Database Capacity: Up to 10 face databases with 10,000 images
General.IMD+ by DVR: 16 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by  leaves, rain and lighting condition change
General.AI Video Quality Analytics: 16 channels: Supports detecting brightness levels, Color cast, Defocus, Overexposure, Contrast  levels, Black and white
General.IP Camera Input: Up to 24 channels of IPC access (8 IP Channels + 16 Analog Channels)                                                   Incoming bandwidth: 128 Mbps, Recording bandwidth: 128 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth:  128 Mbps                                                                                                                                                            *After IP extension is enabled, Video Quality Analytics, Scene Changing, Face Recognition,  Face Detection, IMD, Perimeter Protection and Intellisearch 2.0 cannot be used.
General.Encoding Capacity: Main stream: 5MP Mode: 4 Channel 5MP@1fps-6fps, others 5M-N@1fps-12fps                                      5M-N Mode: 5M-N@1fps–12fps, 4M-N/ 1080p@1fps–15fps, 1080N/ 720p/ 960H/ D1/CIF  @1fps–25/30fps                                                                                                                                                       Sub stream: D1/ CIF@1fps–15fps
General.Video Output: 2 HDMI, 1 VGA, 1 CVBS                                                                                                                                                  HDMI 1: 3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720                                                                    VGA/HDMI 2: 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720                                                                                     It changes to 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720  when Face, IVS & IMD or Intellisearch is  selected in AI Mode.                                                                                                                                  *Heterogeneous video sources output for HDMI2 is configurable.
General.Video Display Split: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4/8/9/16                                                                                  When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/8/9/16/25
General.Video Compression: AI Instastream, Instastream, H.265, H.264+, H.264
General.Audio Compression: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, IPv6, RTSP, UDP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, IP Filter, FTP,  DDNS, SNMP, Alarm Server, InstaOn, Auto Connect, ONVIF (Profile T, Profile S, Profile G), CGI,  SDK
General.Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, IPv6, RTSP, UDP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, IP Filter, FTP,  DDNS, SNMP, Alarm Server, InstaOn, Auto Connect, ONVIF (Profile T, Profile S, Profile G), CGI,  SDK
General.Network Mode: Multi-address mode, Fault tolerance, Load balance
General.Record Mode: General, Alarm, Motion detection, Intelligent, POS
General.Recording Playback: 1/4/9/16       It changes to 1/4/9 split when Face or IVS & IMD is selected in AI Mode.
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Tag playback, Smart playback
General.General Alarm: Motion detection, Local alarm, Alarm box, HDCVI alarm, Camera external alarm, Network  alarm, PIR alarm
General.Abnormality Alarm: Error (No disk, Disk error, Low space, Low quota space, Network disconnection, IP conflict,  MAC conflict), Video loss, Video tampering, Camera offline
General.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection, Face recognition, Perimeter protection, IMD+
General.Alarm Linkage: Record, Snapshot (panoramic), Local alarm output, IPC external alarm output, Audio, Buzzer,  Log, Preset, Email
General.Disk Interface: 8 SATA ports. Each disk can contain up to 16TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperature.
General.Interface Ports: 4 (2 front USB 2.0 ports, 2 rear USB 3.0 ports), 1 RS232, 1 eSATA Port, 1 RS485
